    ┃Keys · 1-19 of 72 · j k g G scroll                                    ┃    
    ┃MOVE  j k ↑ ↓          up / down in the focused panel                 ┃    
    ┃      g G              first / last row                               ┃    
    ┃      tab              next panel: Builds, Stages, Tree               ┃    
    ┃      shift-tab        previous panel                                 ┃    
    ┃      1 2 3            focus Builds, Stages, Tree (on Home: open the  ┃    
    ┃                       plan screen there)                             ┃    
    ┃      enter            drill in: a build's stages, expand a stage,    ┃    
    ┃                       open a triggered plan                          ┃    
    ┃      esc              back one level, close an overlay; from Stages  ┃    
    ┃                       or Tree to Builds; from a triggered plan to    ┃    
    ┃                       its parent; from Builds to Home; from a        ┃    
    ┃                       project's plans to :projects                   ┃    
    ┃HOME  enter            open the plan screen; on a preset, show what   ┃    
    ┃                       it sends                                       ┃    
    ┃      E                edit the selected preset's file                ┃    
    ┃      D                remove the selected preset (asks first)        ┃    
    ┃      s                next sort column                               ┃    
    ┃      :                command bar: :plans :presets :sets :projects   ┃    
    ┃                       :tree :stats :project :server :sort :q         ┃    
    ┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛
